collectionMethod: Manual capture of the official OpenCode Go plan page and docs page (English). Official pricing tables only.
scope: OpenCode Go official price table only. No leaderboard/score data, no Command Goat, no shared-pool changes.

adopted.cacheWriteNote: No cache-write price listed in the official table.

limitedTimeDoubleNotAdopted.reason: CONVENTIONS requires every temporary promotion to carry an end date. The page shows a 2x (→ $60) limited-time credit with no deadline, so it is recorded here as evidence only and is not used for the adopted row.
limitedTimeDoubleNotAdopted.impact: Adopted monthly credit stays at the steady-state $30; monthlyYi would be ~1.522 if and when the doubling is confirmed with a deadline.
